# Laravel PWA (`erag/laravel-pwa`)

> Seamless Progressive Web App (PWA) integration for Laravel applications with automated manifest generation, background service workers, install prompts, and dynamic facade controls.

## Key Links & Documentation
- [Official Documentation](https://erag.in/laravel-pwa/)
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/eramitgupta/laravel-pwa)
- [Packagist Package](https://packagist.org/packages/erag/laravel-pwa)
- [Installation Guide](https://erag.in/laravel-pwa/installation.html)
- [Configuration Reference](https://erag.in/laravel-pwa/configuration.html)
- [Blade Directives](https://erag.in/laravel-pwa/directives.html)
- [PWA Facade API](https://erag.in/laravel-pwa/facade.html)
- [Livewire & Inertia Integrations](https://erag.in/laravel-pwa/frameworks.html)

## Quick Installation
```bash
composer require erag/laravel-pwa
php artisan erag:install-pwa
```

## Blade Directives
In your main HTML layout:
```blade
<head>
    <!-- Injects manifest, apple-touch-icon, and theme-color meta tags -->
    @PwaHead
</head>
<body>
    @yield('content')

    <!-- Registers background service worker & install prompt handler -->
    @RegisterServiceWorkerScript
</body>
```

## Runtime Updates via Facade
```php
use EragLaravelPwa\Facades\PWA;

// Dynamically update manifest properties
PWA::update([
    'name' => 'My App',
    'short_name' => 'App',
    'theme_color' => '#f53003',
    'background_color' => '#ffffff',
]);
```

## Key Capabilities
- Auto-generates `public/manifest.json` from `config/pwa.php`
- In-built offline fallback page served when network disconnects
- Livewire 3 compatibility via `data-navigate-once`
- Full iOS Safari Add to Home Screen support with tooltip guidance
- Dynamic logo resizing and manifest sync via `PWA::processLogo($request)`
